title: sorbus aria subsp. cretica
intro: Sorbus aria subsp. cretica, commonly known as Cretan whitebeam, is a subspecies of the whitebeam tree (Sorbus aria) native to the mountainous regions of Greece. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to provide various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in the treatment of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The therapeutic actions of Sorbus aria subsp. cretica include its ability to modulate the immune system and its antioxidant properties, which can help protect against oxidative stress and cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
